title: Stillwater House
description: A boutique lakeside retreat imagined around an unhurried stay, with room discovery, local experiences, and a clear booking path.
goal: Help a prospective guest picture the stay and find the right room before starting a booking.
approach: Cinematic waterfront photography establishes the mood. Cream editorial sections give the rooms and local experiences space, while consistent booking prompts connect the page from first impression to final invitation.
alt: Complete Stillwater House fictional website concept, from lakeside hero and room choices to local experiences and footer

title: Canopy Home
description: An exterior home-care concept that pairs a distinctive first impression with clear service choices and an easy estimate path.
goal: Help a homeowner understand the available services, the process, and the next step in requesting an estimate.
approach: Warm architectural imagery introduces the business. Service photographs make the choices concrete, a three-step section explains what happens next, and estimate prompts stay consistent throughout the page.
alt: Complete Canopy Home fictional website concept, showing exterior care services, the estimate process, closing invitation, and footer

title: Form & Field
description: An editorial homewares shop imagined around tactile product photography, considered collections, and a story that invites exploration.
goal: Help a shopper discover the collection and understand the design point of view behind the products.
approach: A sculptural product hero creates the first impression. An asymmetric collection feature, clear category paths, and a materials story translate the studio’s cinematic style into a focused retail journey.
alt: Complete Form and Field fictional retail website concept, from sculptural product hero to ceramics, lighting, textiles, materials story, and footer
